facts.fact: The current Senior Citizens Savings Scheme rate is 8.2% per annum (India Post savings page, last updated 19.10.2026, i.e. within Q3 FY 2026-27)
facts.quote: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme Account (SCSS) Rate of Interest: 8.2% per annum

facts.fact: Rates for 1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) were set by DEA's Office Memorandum dated 30.09.2026
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: The NSI rate table shows SCSS at 8.2% from 1.04.2023 to 30.09.2026, so 8.2% in Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026)
DEA's OM of 30.09.2026 keeps the Q3 FY 2026-27 (Oct-Dec 2026) small-savings rates unchanged from Q2, so SCSS stays at 8.2% (neither raised nor cut)
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter
facts.note: DEA OM F.No.1/4/2019-NS dated 30.09.2026, read by OCR of the scanned PDF. 8.2% is derived: the OM gives no rates; the Q2 rate of 8.2% is from NSI (fact 3).

summary: SCSS 8.2% for Q3 FY 2026-27, unchanged from Q2 per DEA OM 30.09.2026 (OCR of R.pdf), confirmed.
